name: Woodcutting
text: Fells more wood from each stand of timber, and is hurt less by falling trees.

name: Mining
text: Cuts more stone from the face, and is hurt less in a rockfall.

name: Farming
text: Brings in a bigger harvest of grain and flax.

name: Fishing
text: Lands more fish, and falls in less often.

name: Herbalism
text: Knows where the herbs grow and picks more of them.

name: Cooking
text: A good cook's meals fill the stomach better and feed the spirit; bakes and brews faster.

name: Healing
text: Nurses the sick through, and in the clinic cures them faster.

name: Carpentry
text: Works wood faster at the bench and wastes less of it.

name: Smithing
text: Works metal faster at the forge and wastes less of it.

name: Tailoring
text: Spins, sews and stitches faster at the loom and wastes less cloth and leather.

name: Music
text: Plays so that it lifts the heart: more fun from every tune.

name: Trading
text: Haggles a better price at the counter and with the caravans.

name: Hunting
text: Stalks and shoots better, and brings home more from every kill.

name: Animal care
text: Gets more from pack animals and rides faster.

name: Masonry
text: Lays stone and tile faster and wastes less of it.
